title: Act on the 2026-10-17 code review
description:
Ryan reviewed the 2026-10-17 full code review of Prospectus and agreed with every finding and recommendation. This epic tracks the fixes. The review document is https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f53880ad-eeb3-4c04-bcf6-82dfb7af4b9a.

Decisions recorded from that review:

- The account model stays as implemented: one organization account with per-product entitlements. Apps own permissions on their own objects, keyed by Prospectus person and account IDs, never exceeding the Prospectus role. Only reviewed operators turn products on or off.
- A single formatting PR lands first; every other fix is stacked on it so later diffs read line by line.
- The PR #18 follow-ups (callable entitlement route) are owned by the "Next moves to get ahead" thread and are not duplicated here. The review's Google OAuth secret finding was a false alarm: the secret Prospectus uses is live in papyrus-production; the deleted copy was an unused one in cyclotron-production.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  F[Format with Prettier, lint in CI] --> B[Native bridge lifetime and S3 scope]
  F --> D[Remove dead code, shared request parser]
  F --> R[Resolve Person once per request]
  F --> S[Sign-in: store session first, one Google login]
  F --> C[CI caching, test:all, Node 24, 202 status]
  F --> O[Docs: README, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY, OPERATIONS]
  D --> P[Named predicates and descriptive names in accounts/]
  B --> P
  R --> P
```

Working rules for every child issue (from Ryan's standing preferences and the review hand-off):

- Branch from `claude/project-thread-3r1x8t` (main plus the Prettier formatting commit) as `claude/project-thread-3r1x8t-<topic>`. Open the PR with base `claude/project-thread-3r1x8t` so the diff shows only the fix; GitHub retargets it to `main` when the formatting PR merges.
- Code style: no comments that explain what a line does; long descriptive names instead. One statement per line. No single-letter identifiers. Validation chains become named predicate functions, each failing with its own message. Run `npm run lint` before committing.
- Verify before pushing. Build the pinned Kanbus UI first (`node infra/scripts/checkout-kanbus.mjs`, then `npm ci` and `npm run build` in `.build/kanbus-ui/packages/ui`), then `npm ci`, `npm ci --prefix packages/accounts-client`, and `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`. Native accounts tests need `npm run build:identity-files` (cargo, several minutes). Infra changes: `npm ci --prefix infra && npm run check --prefix infra`.
- No AWS access from cloud workers; nothing a worker does deploys. No model names in code, commits or PR bodies.
- Order: the formatting PR (kanbus-f1ffd7) merges first, after PR #18. The six wave-1 issues run in parallel. kanbus-dc58ab (named predicates) waits for the dead-code, bridge and read-amplification PRs. The CI issue and the docs issue both edit README.md; whichever lands second rebases.
- The docs issue (kanbus-829a99) must describe the Google OAuth secret as live, not as a deploy risk.
